# contentful_space_enablements (Resource)

Manages Contentful Space Enablements. Destroying this resource removes it from Terraform state without disabling or resetting the remote enablements. Import the existing Space Enablements to resume management. This retention applies while the parent space exists; this resource does not manage the space lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_space_enablements" "this" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id

  cross_space_links = true
  space_templates   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) ID of the space for which enablements are configured. Changing this value replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `cross_space_links` (Boolean) Whether cross-space references are enabled. Omission retains the value returned by Contentful. Contentful may reject unsupported combinations with other space enablements.
- `space_templates` (Boolean) Whether space templates are enabled. Omission retains the value returned by Contentful. Contentful may reject unsupported combinations with other space enablements.
- `studio_experiences` (Boolean) Whether Studio Experiences are enabled. Omission retains the value returned by Contentful.
- `suggest_concepts` (Boolean) Whether concept suggestions are enabled. Omission retains the value returned by Contentful.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier, equal to `space_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    space_id = var.contentful_space_id
  }
  to = contentful_space_enablements.this
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = var.contentful_space_id
  to = contentful_space_enablements.this
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_space_enablements.this "$CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID"
```
